search_audit.query: Open 國 — historical form and meaning
search_audit.outcome: Bronze 國 combines a territorial enclosure 囗 with phonetic 或. The enclosed form occurs in Western Zhou writing. Earlier 或 could itself write the country or territory word. Some Warring States forms vary the enclosure while retaining its boundary function.

search_audit.query: Open 国 — glyph origin and Japanese forms
search_audit.outcome: 国 is a simplified form of 國 with 或 replaced by 玉. It is also the Japanese shinjitai corresponding to 國. The related variant 囯 instead contains 王.
The simplified-form query supplied no usable explanation; consulted the explicitly scoped 國 entry and the 国 form-correspondence entry instead.
